trust.reliability_tooltip: Reliability score (0–100) from employer feedback, hajiri, completed jobs, verified skills, rehiring and tenure. It is not a credit score.

disputes.org_description: Workers can question their hajiri, wages or work record. Reply with what your records show — KaamSathi reviews and closes each dispute.
disputes.ops_description: Disputes raised by workers. Check the employer's reply, correct records through the normal screens if needed, then resolve or reject.
disputes.empty_org: When a worker questions a record, it appears here for your reply.
disputes.empty_ops: Nothing waiting. New disputes from workers will appear here.
disputes.response_hint: Explain what your records show. The worker and KaamSathi will see this.
disputes.no_auto_edit: Closing a dispute does not change hajiri or payslips. Correct those records through the attendance or payroll screens first.
